headline: Short-period south junk at a marginal angle — dawn log session or skip.
today: Waist- to chest-high on the sets but it's 4-5s S swell hitting the wrong angle for 67th, so expect gutless and closed-out. Best shot is the dawn patrol with WSW cross before the SSW cross-on fills in for the afternoon. Grab the log, work the incoming tide toward that 4:27p high, and keep expectations low.

daysToWatch.note: Slightly more push at dawn but the wind ramps to onshore 12-17mph by afternoon and blows it out. Early only.
Under a foot and W wind cranking to 15mph. Flat and junky, don't bother.
